response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.station_avg AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.station_avg - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.station_avg > o.overall_avg ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
